result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

My overall pick is **1Password for ease of use and team management**, but Bitwarden is excellent if keeping costs down is important.

## Best password managers for small teams

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall)

- Excellent user experience.
- Shared vaults with granular permissions.
- Easy onboarding and offboarding.
- Strong admin controls and security reporting.
- Particularly good for non-technical teams.

**Indicative price\:** US\$24.95/month for up to 10 users (Starter Pack), or US\$8.99/user/month for Business.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

- Very competitive pricing.
- Open-source software.
- Shared collections and team management.
- Good security and audit features.
- Self-hosting option.

**Indicative price\:** US\$4/user/month for Teams.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

- Good administrative controls.
- Secure shared folders.
- Strong security and compliance features.
- Useful for businesses with more complex access requirements.

**Indicative price\:** From US\$2/user/month for Business Starter.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Dashlane Logo .PNG and .AI, .EPS, .CDR, .PDF, .SVG - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/LsA7Xy4z5KjqgXpOB9Ng_syAbohPqexBfM3ZI6ca5JPPqcmnARcFKiWcZfWTpB-BUITBeFVjRKkjKxVkJlfk_9dcuiiDUWCGsYyQ6L-Ni7aOjA859CDMeptuITBLl2H2OQFJNRnohymnlsDfcTWAUQ8hhGcP9ngXhm-SNXs0HVwDEmD12G02_nFKWYiM4ji0?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Dashlane**

- Polished interface.
- Password health monitoring.
- Security alerts and phishing protection.
- Useful reporting for administrators.

**Indicative price\:** Around US\$8/user/month.

[Dashlane business plans](https://www.dashlane.com/business)

Prices are indicative USD prices, generally billed annually, checked against available November 2026 comparisons. Confirm Australian pricing, GST and plan inclusions before purchasing. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[cybercred.com.au](https://cybercred.com.au/articles/password-managers-compared-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[vettlo.com](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-password-managers-for-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My comparison

| Feature | 1Password | Bitwarden |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Ease of use | Excellent | Very good |
| Team sharing | Excellent | Excellent |
| Admin controls | Excellent | Very good |
| Security | Excellent | Excellent |
| Price | Higher | Lower |
| Self-hosting | No | Yes |


## What I'd prioritise

For a small business, I'd make sure the manager supports\:

1. **Shared vaults** – everyone can access the credentials they need without sharing passwords through email or Slack.
2. **Individual accounts** – no shared master login between employees.
3. **Access permissions** – restrict sensitive credentials to specific people.
4. **Easy offboarding** – immediately revoke access when someone leaves.
5. **Two-factor authentication (2FA)** – protect the password manager itself.
6. **Audit logs** – understand who accessed or changed shared credentials.

## A couple of questions to narrow it down

I'd like to recommend something that fits your actual setup rather than just the most popular product.

**1\. How many people are in your team?**

2–5

5–10

10–25

25–50

More than 50

---

**2\. What do you primarily use?**

Microsoft 365

Google Workspace

Apple / Mac

A mixture

---

**3\. What's most important?**

Best balance of security and simplicity

Lowest possible cost

Strongest security and administration

Easy password sharing

---

**4\. Approximate budget?**

Under \$5 AUD per user/month

Around \$5–10 AUD per user/month

Over \$10 AUD per user/month

No fixed budget

[Get my recommendation]

I'll use those details to narrow it down to the best one or two options for your business.
